description: 卡特兰开局E06 — 关键时机：dxc4接收与c5反击的节奏

intro.popup_en:
Key Timing, Demo 4: Catalan Opening
White's c4-pawn is exposed. When should Black accept it with ...dxc4? This game studies the best timing for taking the pawn and then countering White's recovery plan.
intro.popup:
关键时机演示4

卡特兰开局！

白方c4兵暴露在外
黑方何时接受这个'礼物'？

练习目标：
掌握dxc4的最佳时机

outro.popup_en: The sequence: accept on c4 only after White has castled; use ...a6 and ...b5 to prevent the queen from recovering immediately; then wait until Be4 is established before striking with ...c5 and eventually recovering the pawn. The timing links the capture and counterbreak.
outro.popup:
卡特兰时机总结

三步时机组合：
① dxc4：O-O后接受才有价值
② a6+b5：阻止后立即夺回
③ c5→Nxc5：Be4控制后推c5再吃回

先吃后反击的节奏！

moves.popup_en: Bg2 fianchettoes the bishop on the long diagonal.

moves.popup:
dxc4！时机！
O-O后接受最有效
moves.popup_en: ...dxc4! Black accepts the pawn at the right moment, after White has castled.
Qc2 prepares to recover the pawn with the queen.
...a6! Black prepares ...b5 to stop the queen from recovering the pawn immediately.
Qxc4 recovers the pawn with the queen.
...b5! Black gains a tempo by driving the queen back again.
Qc2 retreats the queen once more.
...Bb7 places the bishop on the long diagonal.
Be4! White occupies a strong square with the bishop.
...c5! Now that White's bishop is established on e4, Black strikes in the center.
Qc1 retreats the queen to defend.

moves.popup:
Nxc5！时机！
终于吃回多余兵
moves.popup_en: Nxc5! At last White recovers the extra pawn at the right moment.
